title: CandidateMemberReview
description: Trader review decision on a candidate pool member. Rejected candidates are preserved as negative examples for Shadow/preference learning. Agora never places broker orders.

decision.description: Review outcome. 'reject' preserves the candidate as a negative example for preference learning.

rationale.description: Trader-supplied reason. Required when decision is 'reject' or 'park'.

score_override.description: Optional trader weight-override request, recorded for audit and re-ranking.

reviewed_by.description: Operator or persona that recorded this review.

negative_example_tags.description: Rejection reason taxonomy tags; used for preference learning when decision is 'reject'.
